2215|dc484bb4.name: High Executor Darthalia
2215|dc484bb4.text: In order to serve the Dark Lady and Varimathras we need to advance the front on the Human Infestation.

2216|8e0e34da.name: Apothecary Lydon
2216|8e0e34da.text: We are but so close to developing the New Plague that our Dark Lady desires with such fervor.

2238|5408b909.name: Tog'thar
2238|5408b909.text: Marlgen... One of the jailors. He has the key to my bonds.

2238|6d472bad.name: Tog'thar
2238|6d472bad.text: Get away from here, $c, or they'll put you in chains as well.

2239|4513b5ec.name: Drull
2239|4513b5ec.text: Do you mock me while I am unable to defend myself, bound to this ball of iron?

2239|7c058ec5.name: Drull
2239|7c058ec5.text: One of the humans has the key to this infernal contraption. Eston I think they said his name was.

2388|fde1fb79.name: Innkeeper Shay
2388|fde1fb79.text: Rest your weary bones for a spell.

2393|e26243eb.name: Christoph Jeffcoat
2393|e26243eb.text: Can I show you what I have for sale?

262502|3e8465bb.name: Brix Xizzix
262502|3e8465bb.text: When I heard that there was a whole new gaggle of elves literally fallin' from the sky, I said to myself "THAT'S where I need to be". A whole new society of impressionable, bright-eyed suckers... er--customers!

275270|fb00a823.name: Windshapers Dockmaster
275270|fb00a823.text: All travelers bound for Mulgore should depart here.

3191|b48f927f.name: Cook Torka
3191|b48f927f.text: I can teach you how to cook!

3419|dabc0513.name: Apothecary Zamah
3419|dabc0513.text: For our people to survive, we must study the ways of nature and learn its secrets.

3539|8259246a.name: Ott
3539|8259246a.text:
My blades don't glisten, glitter, or gleam, and they'll sing no epic songs about my creations when I'm gone. 

One thing you can be sure of though is that my weapons will cut down all the knights in Stormwind before losing their honed edge.

1060-progress.name: Witch Doctor Jin'Zil
1060-progress.text: You seem a shady character. You have something for me to see?
1060-progress.title: Letter to Jin'Zil

1065-progress.name: Apothecary Lydon
1065-progress.text: Ah, are you here with my new test subjects?
1065-progress.title: Journey to Tarren Mill

1066-progress.name: Apothecary Lydon
1066-progress.text: Did you find the Syndicate Shadow Mages, and collect from them the blood?
1066-progress.title: Blood of Innocents

1067-progress.name: Apothecary Zamah
1067-progress.text: You have returned, $N.  Do you bring aid from Apothecary Lydon?
1067-progress.title: Return to Thunder Bluff

1093-progress.name: Ziz Fizziks
1093-progress.text: Did you find those plans? I'm eager to impress the new boss. Hopefully, once he's convinced of my loyalty--well, as much as he can be convinced... goblin's honor, you know?--he'll feel comfortable making use of my rather impressive genius.
1093-progress.title: Super Reaper 6000

1516-accept.name: Canaga Earthcaller
1516-accept.text:
The time is now, young $c. You've grown strong and your spirit endures like the earth. Following the $c's path shows you have wisdom before even proving yourself.

The element of earth will guide your destiny, becoming part of you if you are ready. But you must stand before the earth itself. If you are ready, then you will see things only $c know of.

Seek out the Felstalkers to the north, and take from them two of their hooves. Return to me then, and we shall speak more of your future.
1516-accept.title: Call of Earth

1516-progress.name: Canaga Earthcaller
1516-progress.text:
Patience is earth's greatest virtue. The earth witnesses the cycle of all things: the mountains becoming deserts; rivers becoming canyons. The earth is the most stubborn and wise of all the elements and it does not tolerate impatience.

The earth beckons you now because a time of conflict draws near. When you return to me successful, then you shall be that much closer to being made whole.

Others will be envious of your wisdom and hate you for their ignorance.
1516-progress.title: Call of Earth

1518-progress.name: Canaga Earthcaller
1518-progress.text:
I wish to be the first to welcome you fully to the first of four paths that will forever lead you in your destiny.

If you have the stone the earth gave to you, I will give you the totem it promised.

If not, then be gone with you until you have found your way.
1518-progress.title: Call of Earth

1524-progress.name: Telf Joolam
1524-progress.text: Greetin's, $N. You've found yourself at the Shrine of the Dormant Flame. Only those knowledgeable enough in the shamanistic arts will ever learn the secrets of this place and the power it holds. I'm sorry you made the trip all this way, only to be turned back now--the journey up here is far from safe after all--but I am the keeper of the shrine, and I cannot allow just anyone to wander around here.
1524-progress.title: Call of Fire

3089-progress.name: Shikrik
3089-progress.text:
So, you've arrived. I was beginning to wonder when you would show yourself. I sent the parchment some time ago--I wasn't sure if it had arrived.

But enough chatter... you're here because you have been chosen, chosen to lead the spiritual lives of our people.
3089-progress.title: Rune-Inscribed Parchment

5042-progress.name: Mangletooth
5042-progress.text:
I will need 4 blood shards if you wish Agamaggan's strength, $r.

Your foes will cower before your strength were you to be given this blessing. <snort>

The Razormane's greatest warriors are infused with such power!
5042-progress.title: Agamaggan's Strength

5043-progress.name: Mangletooth
5043-progress.text:
My tribes greatest scouts are said to be unrivaled in their accuracy, and no rogue <snort> could measure up to their quickness in battle.

Bring me 4 blood shards and I will make you even more agile than any quilboar born.
5043-progress.title: Agamaggan's Agility

5044-progress.name: Mangletooth
5044-progress.text:
The shaman and geomancers of the quilboar tribes <snort> call upon the strength of Agamaggan to help them in battle and in their rituals, $r.

If you too wish the added power of Agamaggan's blessing with your spells, then bring me 4 blood shards and Mangletooth will aid you. <snort>
5044-progress.title: Wisdom of Agamaggan

5045-progress.name: Mangletooth
5045-progress.text:
Warriors of all types <snort> have need of a strong spirit. It drives you to greater feats when all hope has been lost. This is not unknown to the <snort> Razormane. We are a spiritual tribe--we are more proud of our connection to Agamaggan than our prowess <snort> in battle.

Bring me 4 blood shards and I will bless your spirit for battle. <snort>
5045-progress.title: Rising Spirit

5046-progress.name: Mangletooth
5046-progress.text:
All those who <snort> enter battle have need of protection. Their bones must be strong. Their skin tough. <snort> My tribe knows this as well, and to add to the natural protection our quills and hide give us, <snort> we often call upon Agamaggan to protect us from harm before we go to war.

Bring me 4 blood shards <snort> and I will grant you the same protection.
5046-progress.title: Razorhide

5052-progress.name: Mangletooth
5052-progress.text:
Our tribes flock to the thorny areas throughout the Barrens <snort> because they are holy places, but none as holy as Razorfen. Agamaggan's body makes up the entirety of the Razorfen, <snort> but the Downs are especially protected because the entrance is made from his great maw! <snort> It will swallow whole those not loyal to him, and spit out their bodies after he's chewed them up! <snort>

Agamaggan has left his body behind to protect us, and he gives of his spirit so we may protect him. <snort>
5052-progress.title: Blood Shards of Agamaggan

815-progress.name: Cook Torka
815-progress.text: Breakfast, lunch, dinner! Who cares which meal it is? It still has to be cooked by someone--namely me!
815-progress.title: Break a Few Eggs

834-progress.name: Rezlak
834-progress.text: I'm great at what I do, don't get me wrong, but this is ridiculous! What am I supposed to do, build sand castles?
834-progress.title: Winds in the Desert

853-progress.name: Apothecary Zamah
853-progress.text: You have something from Apothecary Helbrim?
853-progress.title: Apothecary Zamah

875-progress.name: Darsok Swiftdagger
875-progress.text: Do you have 6 Harpy Lieutenant Rings yet? Justice must be dealt to them for their vicious attacks on the Horde.
875-progress.title: Harpy Lieutenants

876-progress.name: Darsok Swiftdagger
876-progress.text: You're not getting anything until I see Serena's head.
876-progress.title: Serena Bloodfeather

883-progress.name: Jorn Skyseer
883-progress.text: $N, when you approached I saw a new power in your stride.  Tell me -- has your spirit met with the great Lakota'mani?
883-progress.title: Lakota'mani

884-progress.name: Jorn Skyseer
884-progress.text: $N, there is a new power behind your eyes!  You have met with the mighty Owatanka, have you not?
884-progress.title: Owatanka

889-progress.name: Mangletooth
889-progress.text:
Bring Mangletooth 10 blood shards and I will bless you with great speed. You will run with zhevra and the wind will be jealous of you.

It will not last long, but it should be enough to help you travel throughout the Barrens.
889-progress.title: Spirit of the Wind

899-progress.name: Mankrik
899-progress.text: The quilboar will pay for this, $N. I swear it.
899-progress.title: Consumed by Hatred

913-progress.name: Jorn Skyseer
913-progress.text: Is it done? Have you slain the thunderhawk?
913-progress.title: Cry of the Thunderhawk

95774-progress.name: Mankrik
95774-progress.text: I have only memories now, but I will build a tribute to Olgra so that they never fade.
95774-progress.title: Her Name Is Olgra

96873-accept.name: Pa'zula
96873-accept.text:
The trolls east of here have lost their will to the witchdoctor, Zalazane. He uses many cruel magics to keep hold of his prisoners' minds, but one of his favorite tricks is to make them wear pendants wrapped in evil binding spells.

Practice your enchanting skills by stripping the magic from these pendants, and bring me the results. And don't accidentally put one around your neck, if you value your freedom!
96873-accept.title: A Pain in the Neck

96873-complete.name: Pa'zula
96873-complete.text: Fine work. A shame about the slain trolls, but with the binding spells removed, their spirits can rest.
96873-complete.title: A Pain in the Neck

96873-progress.name: Pa'zula
96873-progress.text: What do you have for me, $N?
96873-progress.title: A Pain in the Neck

97253-progress.name: Wrenix the Wretched
97253-progress.text: Not another word out of you until your pockets are jingling with metal!
97253-progress.title: Parts and Pieces

98340-accept.name: Turak Runetotem
98340-accept.text:
It would seem that you are ready for the next step in your journey, young $c. Dendrite Starblaze has sent for you, and wishes for you to seek him out in Moonglade once again.

You have already learned to call upon the magic to take you to Moonglade, so you should be able to embark immediately if you choose. I would suggest you leave soon, if you wish to continue your druidic training.
98340-accept.title: The Great Cat Spirit

98362-accept.name: Dendrite Starblaze
98362-accept.text:
The time has come for us to part ways once again, young one, as the application of your lessons takes you back to the one who sent you to me. It would seem your instructor, Turak Runetotem, has found a worthy pupil in you. I believe I see one as well. Heed his lessons and you shall soon be able to draw upon the Great Cat Spirit to take its shape.

Go back to whence you came. When the time is right, we will meet again.
98362-accept.title: To Thunder Bluff

98404-complete.name: Avatar of Saeyleenan
98404-complete.text:
Excellent. You have shown you understand the true nature of the cat, and are able to embody the cunning, stealth, and ferocity needed to take my shape.

I now deem you worthy of my blessing, young $c.
98404-complete.title: The Great Windborne Cat Spirit

98404-progress.name: Avatar of Saeyleenan
98404-progress.text: Ah, you have returned. I do hope you have brought the relics with you?
98404-progress.title: The Great Windborne Cat Spirit
